ASUS Prime Radeon RX 9070 OC Edition 16GB GDDR7 Graphics Card

Unleash next-generation gaming performance and high-bandwidth rendering with the ASUS Prime Radeon RX 9070 OC Edition 16GB GDDR7 graphics card, distributed via Turbo Computer Egypt. Built on AMD's latest high-efficiency architecture, this advanced GPU features a massive 16GB of ultra-fast next-gen GDDR7 memory matrix to deliver smooth high-frame-rate gaming at demanding resolutions. The sophisticated 2.5-slot compact profile is engineered to ensure seamless compatibility with small form factor (SFF) desktop setups while keeping thermal management at its peak. Equipped with a premium triple-fan array operating on dual ball bearings, it guarantees exceptional, quiet cooling under extended heavy loads. Factory overclocked for enhanced performance out of the box, this cutting-edge graphics infrastructure is backed by a 3-year official warranty.
